name: core.openwop.workflows.meeting-ops
description: Meeting-ops chains (RFC 0013): less time in and around meetings — an agenda from a stated goal, and notes turned into owned action items. In-app and draft sinks only; replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Goal → Meeting Agenda
chains.description: Turns a one-line meeting goal into a tight, time-boxed agenda and posts it to the team as an in-app notification.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow. MUST match the `events.md` §Types grammar: two or three kebab-case segments under a registered org, never `openwop.`-prefixed (e.g. `example.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: Turn this meeting goal into a tight agenda for a {{params.minutes}}-minute meeting: 3-5 time-boxed items, each with an owner-shaped prompt and the decision it should reach. Add a one-line desired outcome at the top.

chains.label: Notes → Owned Action Items
chains.description: Debriefs raw meeting notes into decisions and action items; a human confirms, and each action becomes a tracked task.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow. MUST match the `events.md` §Types grammar: two or three kebab-case segments under a registered org, never `openwop.`-prefixed (e.g. `example.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: From these meeting notes produce: Decisions (each in one line) · Action items (each a specific task in one line) · Open questions. Extract only what the notes support — do not invent owners or dates.

config.title: Confirm the action items before filing tasks
